notes.title: Realm Hacker 1.2.1.5 update released
notes.content: -bug fix: Fixed the display error of leaderboard list items.

notes.title: Realm Hacker 1.2.1.3 patch released
notes.content: -bug fixed: Some AIBot has wrong movement in Pi mode.

notes.title: Realm Hacker 1.2.1.2 patch released
notes.content:
-Bug fixed:
1. After selecting the quick restart level function, the lives count displays an error condition.
2. After selecting the quick restart level function in the Pause menu, it cannot return to the normal restart level state.

notes.title: Realm Hacker 1.2.1.1 patch released
notes.content: +New Quick restart level function: You can quick restart level by press F9 key( or press both Left Trigger and Right Trigger button using controller ) directly in Pause Menu and Score Menu. This function can shorten the restart level time from about 10 seconds to 3 seconds.
